title: Item 9: Expand OREF Alert Region Coverage

inputs.description: Expand the ALERT_REGIONS in src/services/orefAlertService.ts from 22 cities to comprehensive coverage. (1) Add missing major cities and towns: Givatayim, Raanana, Kfar Saba, Eilat, Arad, Dimona, Yavne, Lod, Ramla, Beit Shemesh, Maalot-Tarshiha, Kiryat Motzkin, Kiryat Bialik, Tirat Carmel, Nesher, Or Akiva, Caesarea, Zichron Yaakov, Pardes Hanna, Hadera, Afula, Yokneam, Migdal HaEmek, Nazareth, Carmiel, and other settlements near Gaza and Lebanon borders. (2) Fix the fragile substring matching at lines 64-65 to use normalized exact matching with fuzzy fallback. (3) Add a fallback "general alert" mode that triggers for any OREF alert when the user's location doesn't match a specific region - show a generic warning with no countdown rather than silently ignoring.
inputs.title: Expand OREF Alert Region Coverage
